## Automated Tests Required

### GE-001: Cell State Machine + Gate Period Timing — Logic

**Test file**: `tests/unit/gridexplosion/cell_state_machine_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD AC-1/2/3/4/4b + ADR-0002/0006):

- **Cyclic state sequence (AC-1)**: 1 gate cell; clock advances `GATE_PERIOD × 3`; recorded state changes = `[EXPLODED, IDLE, EXPLODED, IDLE, EXPLODED, IDLE]`; non-gate cell always returns `IDLE`
- **Timing accuracy ±16ms (AC-2)**: 100 cycles at `GATE_PERIOD=2.0, T_EX=0.35`; every transition within ±16ms of expected time
- **Encapsulation (AC-3)**: No external API can force-set cell state; `getCellState()` unchanged after any external call
- **CELL_STATE_CHANGED events (AC-4)**: Exactly 4 events per 2 cycles; payloads in order `EXPLODED, IDLE, EXPLODED, IDLE`; each has `{ cellId, newState, timestamp }`; `timestamp = clock.now() ±0.001s`
- **setGatePeriod range (AC-4b)**: 1.6→applied; 1.4→applied (floor); 2.0→applied (ceiling); 1.3→rejected+warn; 2.1→rejected+warn; internal value unchanged after rejection
- **SAFE_WIN invariant**: `GATE_PERIOD - T_EX >= 0.45` for all valid period values

**Edge cases**: GATE_PERIOD=1.4 (floor boundary); offset=0 and offset=GATE_PERIOD/2; clock starts at t=5.0 (non-zero); setGatePeriod called during EXPLODED state

**Estimated test count**: ~12 unit tests

### GE-002: Explosion Death Detection — Logic

**Test file**: `tests/unit/gridexplosion/death_detection_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD AC-5/6/7/8 + ADR-0002/0005):

- **Move-first ordering (AC-5, EC-2)**: Player at `{3,3}`; gate expires ≤1 tick; move to `{3,4}` same tick; player NOT killed; `CELL_EXPLODED` has empty `killedPlayerIds[]`
- **DANGER_ZONE landing (AC-6)**: Player moves to EXPLODED cell; `PLAYER_KILLED { cause: 'DANGER_ZONE' }` emitted immediately; no duplicate
- **Simultaneous death array (AC-7)**: 2 players on same exploding cell; single `PLAYER_KILLED` event; `playerIds: [p1,p2]`; processing order A→B and B→A yields identical events
- **Cause field accuracy (AC-8)**: (a) cell explodes under player → `cause='EXPLOSION'`; (b) player moves to EXPLODED cell → `cause='DANGER_ZONE'`

**Edge cases**: 3 players on same exploding cell; 0 players on exploding cell → no PLAYER_KILLED; player moves to destination that also explodes same tick

**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

### GE-003: Pattern Validation + GRID_STALLED Chain — Integration

**Test file**: `tests/integration/gridexplosion/pattern_validation_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD AC-9/10/11/12/EC-RM-5b + ADR-0009):

- **Valid pattern passes (AC-9)**: 56 gate + 8 connected safe cells; `PATTERN_REJECTED` NOT emitted; all 56 gate cells have active timers
- **MIN_SAFE_CELLS violation (AC-10)**: 57 gate cells (7 safe); `PATTERN_REJECTED { reason: 'MIN_SAFE_CELLS' }` once; zero gate timers
- **BFS disconnected rejection (AC-11)**: 8 safe cells in 2 islands; `PATTERN_REJECTED { reason: 'BFS_DISCONNECTED' }` once; zero timers
- **GRID_STALLED after 3 failures + 3.0s (AC-12)**: 3 consecutive invalid patterns; `FrameClock.schedule(fn, 3.0)` fires; `GRID_STALLED` emitted ±16ms; `ESCALATION_COMPUTED { stalledFallback: true }` received in next flush frame
- **applyEmptyPattern terminal (EC-RM-5b)**: Chain calls `applyEmptyPattern()`; all 64 cells → IDLE; no gate timers; round continues

**Formula under test** (F-5 from GDD): `N_safe = 64 - cells.length >= 8` AND BFS 4-directional single connected region

**Estimated test count**: ~8 integration tests

### GE-004: Event Schema + Edge Cases + Performance — Logic

**Test file**: `tests/unit/gridexplosion/events_edge_cases_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD AC-16~24 + ADR-0002/0005/0006):

- **CELL_EXPLODED schema (AC-16)**: 2 players same cell → `CELL_EXPLODED` emitted 1× with both IDs in `killedPlayerIds[]`
- **No PLAYER_KILLED when empty (AC-17)**: Cell explodes with no players → `PLAYER_KILLED` 0 times; `CELL_EXPLODED(cellId,[])` emitted
- **Timestamp on all events (AC-18)**: Clock pinned at `t=5.5`; all event timestamps = 5.5 ±0.001s
- **Performance 64-cell update (AC-19)**: 1,000 `update(dt)` iterations; max time < 16.6ms; avg < 4ms
- **Worst-case 64-cell simultaneous (AC-20)**: All 64 cells explode same frame; 64 `CELL_STATE_CHANGED` + 64 `CELL_EXPLODED`; time < 16.6ms
- **Double-death guard (AC-21)**: Player under 2 simultaneous explosions; `PLAYER_KILLED` emitted exactly 1×; `killedThisFrame` guard prevents second judgment
- **setGatePeriod during EXPLODED preserves T_EX (AC-22, EC-5)**: 0.3s remaining; `setGatePeriod(1.6)` called; Idle restore at expected time; next cycle uses 1.25s SAFE_WIN
- **No ROUND_END from GridSimulation (AC-23, EC-3)**: Last player's cell explodes; `PLAYER_KILLED` + `CELL_EXPLODED` emitted; `ROUND_END` NOT emitted; timers continue
- **Boundary coord rejection (AC-24, EC-7)**: Pattern with `{row:-1}` and `{row:8}` coords; `console.warn` per invalid coord; valid coords processed; no exception

**Estimated test count**: ~16 unit tests

**Test file**: `tests/unit/patternlibrary/pattern_data_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD AC-PL-1/2/3/4/11 + ADR-0007):

- **Build-time BFS verification (AC-PL-1)**: All `PatternRecord.bfsVerified === true`; test fails on any false record
- **Safe cell minimum (AC-PL-2)**: `64 - cells.length >= 8` for every record
- **MVP pattern count (AC-PL-3)**: Total = 20; T1 = 7; T2 = 8; T3 = 5
- **Category coverage (AC-PL-4)**: All 15 slots `{tier:1..3} × {LINE,CROSS,DIAGONAL,ISLAND,COMPOSITE}` each ≥ 1 record
- **ExplodePattern contract (AC-PL-11)**: `toExplodePattern()` output = `{ cells, patternId }` only; no tier/category/bfsVerified fields; all coords `row,col ∈ [0,7]`

**Formula under test** (F-1): `N_safe = 64 - cells.length ∈ [8, 56]`

**Estimated test count**: ~8 unit tests

### PL-002: Deterministic Pattern Selection + Recency Window — Logic

**Test file**: `tests/unit/patternlibrary/pattern_selection_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD AC-PL-5/6/10 + ADR-0007):

- **Deterministic selection (AC-PL-5)**: Same seed + same pool; 100 calls; always same `patternId`
- **Recency window active (AC-PL-6)**: T1 pool=7 → N_recent=3; T3 pool=5 → N_recent=2; same `patternId` not selected within N_recent rounds
- **N_recent auto-shrink (AC-PL-10)**: Pool=4 → N_recent=2; selection succeeds; no exception
- **First round empty recency (EC-5)**: `recentIds=[]`; full tier pool used; deterministic pick by seed

**Formulas under test** (F-2, F-3): `N_recent = min(3, floor(tier_pool_size/2))`; `selected_index = seed % candidates.length`

**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

### PL-003: Runtime Validation + GRID_STALLED Chain — Integration

**Test file**: `tests/integration/patternlibrary/stalled_chain_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD AC-PL-7/8/9 + ADR-0009):

- **PATTERN_REJECTED on failure (AC-PL-7)**: Runtime MIN_SAFE or BFS violation → `PATTERN_REJECTED { patternId, reason, timestamp }` once; PATTERN_READY NOT emitted; failCount incremented
- **GRID_STALLED after exactly 3 failures (AC-PL-8)**: 3 consecutive failures → `GRID_STALLED { roundNumber, timestamp }` once; retry count = 3 (not 2, not 4)
- **Invalid tier fallback (AC-PL-9)**: tier=0 → `PATTERN_REJECTED { reason:'INVALID_TIER' }`; tier=1 retry attempted; if retry succeeds → PATTERN_READY
- **stalledFallback tier demotion (EC-3)**: stalledFallback=true with tier=2; tier demoted to 1; retry ×3 before re-emitting GRID_STALLED; all via EventBus flush (no synchronous recursion); chain depth ≤ 9 frames
- **failCount resets on ROUND_STARTED**: 2 failures; ROUND_STARTED; 1 more failure → no GRID_STALLED (count = 1, not 3)

**Estimated test count**: ~10 integration tests

### PM-001: Direction8 Movement + Boundary + JOY_THRESHOLD — Logic

**Test file**: `tests/unit/playermovement/grid_movement_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD AC-PM-1/2/3/10/12/20 + ADR-0005):

- **Direction8 delta table (AC-PM-1)**: All 8 directions from `{3,3}`; targets match F-2 delta table exactly
- **Boundary rejection — no position change (AC-PM-2)**: Boundary cell + out-of-bounds direction; coord unchanged
- **Boundary rejection — buffer preserved (AC-PM-3)**: Buffer entry intact after failed boundary move
- **JOY_THRESHOLD filter (AC-PM-10)**: Magnitude < 18px → no direction; no move; threshold=18 is inclusive
- **Imminent cell passthrough (AC-PM-12)**: Move to about-to-explode cell not pre-blocked
- **Angle boundary mapping (AC-PM-20)**: `round(angle/45) % 8` at all 8 boundary angles (22.5°, 67.5°, ...)

**Formulas under test** (F-1, F-2, F-3): Angle→Direction8; target coord calculation; boundary validity check

**Estimated test count**: ~14 unit tests

### PM-002: Input Buffering + Logical Coord + Event Split — Logic

**Test file**: `tests/unit/playermovement/input_buffer_event_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD AC-PM-4/5/6/7/14/18/18b + ADR-0008):

- **Logical coord at t=0 (AC-PM-4)**: `getCellCoord()` returns destination the moment `executeMove()` is called; before tween visually completes
- **Input buffering (AC-PM-5)**: Valid input during tween stored in single-slot buffer; no immediate move
- **Buffer overwrite (AC-PM-6)**: Direction A then B during same tween → only B in buffer
- **Buffer auto-execute (AC-PM-7)**: Tween completes; buffer fires immediately
- **Buffer recompute (AC-PM-14, EC-3)**: Buffered direction invalid from new position → consumed without move
- **PLAYER_MOVED event (AC-PM-18)**: `{ playerId, from, to, timestamp }` emitted at t=0; `timestamp = clock.now() ±0.001`
- **PLAYER_ARRIVED event (AC-PM-18b)**: Emitted at t=0.1s via `FrameClock.schedule`; NOT at t=0

**Formula under test** (F-4): `visual_pos(t) = lerp(start, target, t/MOVE_TWEEN_DURATION)` — logic coord is independent of visual

**Estimated test count**: ~12 unit tests

### PM-003: Death Handling + Edge Cases — Logic

**Test file**: `tests/unit/playermovement/death_edge_cases_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD AC-PM-8/9/11/13/15/16/17/19 + ADR-0008/0005):

- **Dead state — no move (AC-PM-8)**: After PLAYER_KILLED; input ignored; coord unchanged
- **Dead state — buffer clear (AC-PM-9)**: PLAYER_KILLED with active buffer → buffer = null; no move
- **Source cell explosion during tween (AC-PM-11, EC-1)**: Tween active; source cell explodes; `logicalCoord` already at destination → player NOT killed
- **EXPLODED cell landing (AC-PM-13)**: Move to EXPLODED cell → `PLAYER_KILLED { cause: 'DANGER_ZONE' }` (via GridSimulation integration)
- **Cross movement (AC-PM-15, EC-4)**: A moves X→Y, B moves Y→X simultaneously; both arrive; no collision
- **Death+buffer same tick (AC-PM-16, EC-6)**: Death processing before buffer execution; buffer cleared
- **Round-end tween snap (AC-PM-17, EC-7)**: ROUND_CLEAR during tween → visual snaps to logical coord; pending PLAYER_ARRIVED cancelled
- **Multi-player same cell (AC-PM-19)**: Two players move to same cell; both succeed; no collision kill

**Estimated test count**: ~14 unit tests

### PM-004: Server Authority — Integration

**Test file**: `tests/integration/playermovement/server_authority_test.ts`

**What to test** (from GDD TR-PM-012/013 + ADR-0010):

- **MOVE message on valid local move**: `{ direction, fromCell: CellIndex, timestamp }` sent; `fromCell = pre-move CellIndex`; NOT sent on boundary-rejected move
- **Remote PLAYER_MOVE broadcast**: `toCell: CellIndex` → `indexToCoord()` → remote player coord updated; no local boundary validation applied; visual tween starts
- **Optimistic local apply**: Move applied at t=0; not blocked by simulated 200ms server latency

**Conversion formula under test**: `CellIndex = row*8+col`; `row = floor(index/8)`, `col = index%8`

**Estimated test count**: ~6 integration tests

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify via `/smoke-check sprint` before any QA hand-off:

1. Game scene loads without crash
2. `GridSimulation` with 1 gate cell: IDLE → EXPLODED → IDLE cycle completes at correct timing (±16ms)
3. `applyPattern()` with valid 56-gate pattern: all 56 cells activate timers; 8 safe cells remain IDLE
4. `applyPattern()` with 57-gate pattern: `PATTERN_REJECTED` emitted; no crash
5. `PatternLibrary.selectPattern()` with T1 pool: deterministic result for known seed
6. Player move input: `PLAYER_MOVED` at t=0; `PLAYER_ARRIVED` at t+0.1s
7. Player on exploding cell: `PLAYER_KILLED` emitted; player enters Dead state
8. `update(dt)` for 64 cells: completes in < 16.6ms (perf sanity check)
9. No `Date.now()` calls in game logic (grep: `Date\.now\(\)` in `src/`)

*Run `/smoke-check sprint` after all Logic/Integration stories are implemented and before beginning Visual/Feel stories.*

## Definition of Done — Sprint 2

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence
- [ ] Test file exists at the path listed in this plan (Logic/Integration stories) — `/story-done` validates this
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists with sign-off (Visual/Feel stories)
- [ ] No `Date.now()` / `performance.now()` in production game code (enforced by grep in smoke-check)
- [ ] No `CellIndex` used in game logic (only serialization) — enforced by code review
- [ ] Code reviewed via `/code-review` or peer review documented
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` via `/story-done`
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint`) before QA hand-off

**Sprint complete when**: All Must Have stories (GE-001 through GE-004, PL-001 through PL-003, PM-001 through PM-004) are DONE + smoke check passes. Visual/Feel stories (GE-005, PL-004, PM-005) may complete into Sprint 3 if playtest scheduling requires it.

| Risk | Story | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|-------|--------|-----------|
| AC-19/20 perf numbers differ on mobile vs CI desktop | GE-004 | False pass in CI, fail on device | Run perf tests on real device; document environment in evidence |
